label: Simplified ITB rules for demo
description: Match score = w_fit*fit + w_distance*(1 - d/d_max) + w_lead_time*(1 - lead/lead_max) + w_itb_value*itb_norm (CLAUDE.md §3.3). Each term is clamped to [0, 1].

itb_norm.note: SMEs earn 2x direct credit (ITB overview), so they score higher.

tolerance.note: Tolerance is a score term, not a hard filter (docs/api.md §1).

envelope.margin: min over sorted dims of (shop_dim - job_dim) / shop_dim

tie_break: higher score first, then lower shop id
assignment: Greedy fallback: hardest job first (fewest shops passing every filter except capacity; ties by higher est_value_cad, then job id); each job goes to the best-scoring shop that passes every filter including remaining capacity. After funding, only still-blocked jobs are re-routed; existing assignments stay.
